text:
elaine: Heads up — AcmeCorp is pushing hard. They want SOC2 baseline + EU data residency before we enable SSO + Customer Analytics. They gave a Q2 deadline and are tying it to a purchase commitment. We have Customer Insights planned for Q1. Do we gate the feature on compliance or ship a limited variant? Looking for quick prioritization framework input (RICE or similar) and a practical launch checklist.

mike-eng: Quick RICE idea: Reach: medium (targeted enterprise), Impact: high, Confidence: 60%, Effort: 6 wks infra + 2 sprints product. If we treat compliance as effort=blocking for that customer, score shifts. Can we do a phased ship: feature behind flag + tenant isolation?

sarah-sec: For large enterprise customers like AcmeCorp, SOC2 controls are non-negotiable for us to claim compliant handling. Type I/II timing matters — Type II is months. We can do a limited controls package (encryption at rest, scoped logging, DPA) in ~6-8 weeks but full Type II takes longer. Also GDPR DSRs/erasure flow needs design.

jordan-sales: They said they'd sign a 12mo commit if we can guarantee roadmap + a targeted compliance plan. They're ok with a limited beta for now if we can promise regional data residency and contract terms. Can we map a minimum viable compliance surface to unblock the deal?

vikram-legal: Contractually we can offer a DPA + SCCs where needed. But marketing claims ("SOC2-compliant") require an attestation. If we advertise compliance prematurely it creates risk. Recommend: negotiate a technical and contractual mitigation and mark compliance as a delivery milestone in the SOW.

olga-prodops: Proposal: create a launch gating checklist and RICE for both items (Compliance work vs Feature). Example checklist items: `- DPA signed; - Regional storage configured; - Basic access controls + audit logs; - Customer-specific rollout flag; - SLA adjustments in contract`. If those are met, allow a customer-limited GA behind a tenancy flag. That keeps hosted roadmap moving and isolates risk.

mike-eng: Tech note: tenant isolation + region pinning requires infra tasks: network routes, storage buckets, KMS keys, and rollout policy. Estimate ~40 story points + 2-week ops runway for runbook + rollback plan. We can parallelize some work with product if legal signs DPA fast.

elaine: Decision proposal: run a short RICE calc now (feature vs compliance scoping). If AcmeCorp is strategic, fast-track the compliance checklist as a blocking item for their contract only (dedicated gating). Ship a limited-feature beta to other customers. Action items: @mike-eng estimate exact sprint plan, @sarah-sec identify minimal controls for tenant-only attestation, @vikram-legal draft DPA clause, @jordan-sales confirm if customer accepts phased timeline. We'll reconvene EOD. :white_check_mark:

olga-prodops: I'll create the checklist doc and a tiny RICE sheet in the product drive and tag folks. Also add canary rollout steps + rollback signal thresholds.

elaine: Thanks — if we can get contractual cover + region pinning, this feels like a sane compromise. If anyone sees a blocker call it out now. :eyes:
